metrics.prompt: How many articles were published by each editorial desk?
metrics.definition: Total staged articles grouped by normalized editorial_desk channel.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, COUNT(*) AS articles_published FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY articles_published DESC

metrics.prompt: Which editorial desks generated the highest cumulative social shares?
metrics.definition: Sum of article shares across each normalized editorial desk.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, SUM(shares) AS total_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY total_shares DESC

metrics.prompt: What is the average share reach per article across editorial desks?
metrics.definition: Arithmetic mean of article shares per desk.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, ROUND(AVG(shares), 2) AS avg_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY avg_shares DESC

metrics.prompt: What percentage of stories per desk hit the high-velocity >=3,400 share threshold?
metrics.definition: Share of articles reaching >= 3,400 social shares (top-decile proxy).
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN shares >= 3400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS viral_rate_pct FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY viral_rate_pct DESC

metrics.prompt: What share of stories beat the 1,400-share median benchmark by desk?
metrics.definition: Percentage of stories reaching >= 1,400 shares.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN shares >= 1400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS above_median_pct FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY above_median_pct DESC

metrics.prompt: How does publishing volume and mean share reach vary by day of week?
metrics.definition: Article counts and average shares by publication weekday.
metrics.sql: SELECT publish_weekday, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 1) AS avg_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY publish_weekday ORDER BY avg_shares DESC

metrics.prompt: Do weekend stories outperform weekday stories on average share velocity?
metrics.definition: Comparison of is_weekend = 1 vs is_weekend = 0 log and raw shares.
metrics.sql: SELECT is_weekend, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 2) AS avg_shares, ROUND(AVG(log1p_shares), 4) AS avg_log1p_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY is_weekend ORDER BY is_weekend

metrics.prompt: Which desk-days experienced >= 2.0 SD traffic spikes above their 14-day baseline?
metrics.definition: Desk-days flagged where rolling_14d_zscore >= 2.0.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, COUNT(*) AS spike_days, ROUND(MAX(rolling_14d_zscore), 2) AS peak_zscore FROM fct_editorial_desk_daily WHERE is_traffic_spike_2sigma = 1 GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY spike_days DESC

metrics.prompt: How many articles have zero parsed body tokens due to upstream scraper failures?
metrics.definition: Count of staged articles where body_word_count = 0.
metrics.sql: SELECT editorial_desk, SUM(flag_zero_body_parser_defect) AS zero_body_rows, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(flag_zero_body_parser_defect) / COUNT(*), 2) AS defect_rate_pct FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY editorial_desk ORDER BY zero_body_rows DESC

metrics.prompt: How many stories lack an assigned editorial desk tag?
metrics.definition: Count of articles flagged with missing channel taxonomy.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(flag_missing_desk_taxonomy) AS unassigned_articles, COUNT(*) AS total_articles, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(flag_missing_desk_taxonomy) / COUNT(*), 2) AS unassigned_pct FROM stg_editorial_articles

metrics.prompt: How do stories with embedded video perform versus text-only stories?
metrics.definition: Comparison of clean articles with video_count > 0 vs video_count = 0.
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN video_count > 0 THEN 'Has Video' ELSE 'No Video' END AS video_segment, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 1) AS avg_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles WHERE flag_zero_body_parser_defect = 0 GROUP BY video_segment

metrics.prompt: Does deeper internal cross-linking associate with higher share performance?
metrics.definition: Average shares segmented by internal_link_count bucket.
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN internal_link_count >= 3 THEN '3+ Internal Links' ELSE '0-2 Internal Links' END AS link_tier, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 1) AS avg_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles WHERE flag_zero_body_parser_defect = 0 GROUP BY link_tier

metrics.prompt: What headline token length band yields the strongest audience shares?
metrics.definition: Mean shares bucketed across compact, medium, and long headlines.
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN title_word_count <= 8 THEN 'Short (<=8)' WHEN title_word_count <= 12 THEN 'Standard (9-12)' ELSE 'Long (13+)' END AS headline_band, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 1) AS avg_shares FROM stg_editorial_articles GROUP BY headline_band ORDER BY avg_shares DESC

metrics.prompt: Do visual-rich articles (>=3 images) earn higher high-velocity rates?
metrics.definition: Viral share rate segmented by embedded image count.
metrics.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN image_count >= 3 THEN '3+ Images' ELSE '0-2 Images' END AS image_tier, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN shares >= 3400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS viral_rate_pct FROM stg_editorial_articles WHERE flag_zero_body_parser_defect = 0 GROUP BY image_tier

metrics.prompt: How strongly does historical keyword share velocity separate story reach?
metrics.definition: Top vs non-top keyword share velocity comparison using CTE quartile split.
metrics.sql: WITH ranked AS (  SELECT shares, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_keyword_share_velocity) AS kw_quartile   FROM stg_editorial_articles) SELECT kw_quartile, COUNT(*) AS articles, ROUND(AVG(shares), 1) AS avg_shares FROM ranked GROUP BY kw_quartile ORDER BY kw_quartile

metrics.prompt: How many desk-day aggregate records are available in the governed BI mart?
metrics.definition: Row count and total articles reconciled inside fct_editorial_desk_daily.
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS desk_day_rows, SUM(published_articles) AS reconciled_articles, SUM(total_shares) AS reconciled_shares FROM fct_editorial_desk_daily

metrics.prompt: What are the 2-week reader visit rates across randomized newsletter A/B arms?
metrics.definition: Assigned users, visits, and visit rate by experiment arm.
metrics.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS assigned_readers, SUM(visit) AS visits, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(visit), 3) AS visit_rate_pct FROM raw_newsletter_experiment GROUP BY segment ORDER BY visit_rate_pct DESC

metrics.prompt: What are conversion rates and total spend across randomized newsletter arms?
metrics.definition: Assigned readers, conversions, conversion rate, and revenue by arm.
metrics.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS assigned_readers, SUM(conversion) AS conversions, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(conversion), 3) AS conversion_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_spend FROM raw_newsletter_experiment GROUP BY segment ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC

metrics.prompt: How did newsletter treatment arms perform specifically among new readers?
metrics.definition: Visit and conversion breakdown conditioned on newbie = 1 vs 0.
metrics.sql: SELECT newbie, segment, COUNT(*) AS assigned_readers, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(visit), 2) AS visit_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(conversion), 3) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM raw_newsletter_experiment GROUP BY newbie, segment ORDER BY newbie, visit_rate_pct DESC

metrics.prompt: How do experiment visit rates vary across prior reader acquisition channels?
metrics.definition: Visit rate grouped by historical acquisition channel and treatment assignment.
metrics.sql: SELECT channel, segment, COUNT(*) AS readers, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(visit), 2) AS visit_rate_pct FROM raw_newsletter_experiment GROUP BY channel, segment ORDER BY channel, visit_rate_pct DESC
